requirement: A recipient-free Joomla Business opportunity demo retains its native form and cannot submit messages

oracle.ref: PR #1474 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence-wo-demo-contact-preview.md; Opal Moon on wo2, 19/10/2026: native form restored and direct POST 409.
oracle.invariant: The existing controls remain visible, submit is disabled and a preview notice is shown. Missing-recipient submissions stop before dispatch; configured recipients keep the native form. Only the site of the Joomla Business WO build is targeted; failures save no ready hand-off and retries resume the held job.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: only the Joomla Business site of this Website Opportunities build prepares its native form
a refused install or an unreadable receipt never claims the demo form is prepared
the installer is polled to completion and host failures prevent a successful hand-off
a retry resumes the recorded host job instead of installing twice
a failed contact preparation saves no ready hand-off and uploads no pictures
the native layout gains preview support exactly once and unknown layouts are refused
a missing recipient previews the original controls and disables submit without changing reset
forged contact submissions stop before dispatch; configured recipients and other screens pass through
a configured contact renders the native form unchanged
